question: tan (θ - 4π) is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

tan (θ - 4π)

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dad695d8a9dfdb932c5f820606b333cd66e4f1f8bbfe272b04c55b612e9df400.png] 

**Calculation:**

tan (θ - 4π)

⇒ tan{- (4π - θ)}

⇒ - tan(4π - θ)

⇒ -(-tanθ)

⇒ tanθ

**∴ The required answer is tanθ.**
